marketing_description: The DeWALT DCF510B cordless ratchet features a brushless motor that delivers up to 75 ft-lbs of torque, making it suitable for demanding fastening applications. This tool offers versatility with its 3/8 and 1/2 in. square drive interchangeable anvils and has a sealed head design to protect internal components. Its glass-filled nylon housing and integrated LED worklight also contribute to its functionality in various work environments.
